summary: RFC 4412 defines the Resource-Priority Namespaces and Priority-values registries with a management policy of Standards Action. This document updates RFC 4412 to change that policy to IETF Review.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 7134 changes the review policy for the Resource-Priority Namespaces and Priority-values registries from Standards Action to IETF Review. It updates RFC 4412 and says it adds no security considerations beyond that document.

questions: ietf review for sip resource priority namespaces
what is ietf review for sip resource priority
subtitle: A change to the review policy for Resource-Priority registry entries

tldr.problem: Standards Action required a Standards Track document even for a new namespace and priorities that added no protocol semantics.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC changes the management policy for two Resource-Priority registries from Standards Action to IETF Review.
tldr.outcome: RFC 7134 updates RFC 4412 and says the change adds no security considerations beyond that RFC.

today: RFC 7134 updates RFC 4412 with a change to the Resource-Priority registry management policy.

sections.title: Why Change the Policy
sections.content:
RFC 4412 defines the Resource-Priority Namespaces and Resource-Priority Priority-values registries. Their management policy was Standards Action.

The RFC says a document that only defines a new namespace and its priorities, without creating new protocol semantics, should not need to be a Standards Track document. It therefore changes the registries' policy to IETF Review.
sections.plainLanguage: A proposal that only adds a namespace and priorities may not need a full Standards Track document. This RFC changes the review rule for those registry entries.

sections.title: The Updated Registry Rule
sections.content:
The new management policy is IETF Review for both the Resource-Priority Namespaces registry and the Resource-Priority Priority-values registry. The RFC states that IANA has changed the policy for both registries.

This document normatively updates RFC 4412.
sections.plainLanguage: Both named registries now use IETF Review for new entries, replacing the earlier Standards Action policy.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC says it does not introduce security considerations beyond those discussed in RFC 4412.
sections.plainLanguage: The document changes registry management and adds no security considerations beyond RFC 4412.
